title: 육군정보통신학교령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Commandant)
(1) The Army Information and Communications School shall have a Commandant.
(2) The Commandant shall be appointed from among general officers of the Army or civilian military employees of Grade 2 or higher. <Amended on September 2, 2025>
(3) The Commandant shall, under orders from the Chief of Staff of the Army, exercise overall control over academic affairs and command and supervise the staff departments and units.
(4) If the Commandant is unable to perform duties due to an unavoidable reason, the senior officer among the Head of Administration and the Head of the Faculty shall act on behalf of the Commandant.
